description: Source code for the MasqueClientSession class, implementing MASQUE protocol client-side logic including connection management, stream handling, and IP packet encapsulation over HTTP/3 datagrams.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession
classes.description: Manages MASQUE protocol client session, including connection, stream, and encapsulation handling.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::ConnectUdpClientState
classes.description: Represents state for a CONNECT-UDP request, handling HTTP/3 datagram processing.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::ConnectIpClientState
classes.description: Represents state for a CONNECT-IP request, handling IP packet encapsulation over HTTP/3.

methods.name: GetOrCreateConnectUdpClientState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a CONNECT-UDP client state for a given server address and session.

methods.name: GetOrCreateConnectIpClientState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a CONNECT-IP client state for a given IP session.

methods.name: SendIpPacket
methods.description: Encapsulates and sends an IP packet over HTTP/3 datagram.

methods.name: SendPacket
methods.description: Sends a generic packet to a target server address via a CONNECT-UDP stream.

methods.name: CloseConnectUdpStream
methods.description: Closes all CONNECT-UDP streams associated with a session.

methods.name: CloseConnectIpStream
methods.description: Closes all CONNECT-IP streams associated with an IP session.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the connection is closed, closing all encapsulated sessions.

methods.name: OnStreamClosed
methods.description: Handles stream closure events, cleaning up associated session state.

methods.name: OnSettingsFrame
methods.description: Processes received SETTINGS frame and verifies support for HTTP/3 datagrams.

methods.name: GetFakeAddress
methods.description: Generates and registers a fake IP address associated with a hostname.

methods.name: RemoveFakeAddress
methods.description: Removes a previously registered fake IP address.
